scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.metric_basis: FY27E EBITDA (Street consensus ₹5,828.73mn + ₹728mn combined favorable levers)
scenarios.drivers: Customer-acquisition opex stays pulled back rather than resuming to the guided ₹10cr/qtr run-rate; ARPU keeps compounding at its observed ~8%/yr pace; Accounting Software Services sustains its 43% FY26 billing-growth pace with margin improving; multiple expands toward (not to) the translated own-history mean as the 3-quarter negative-net-supplier-adds trend visibly reverses. 12-month horizon.

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.drivers: Consensus FY27E revenue growth (+9.6%) and margin (~flat vs FY26) play out as forecast, with no resumption of the compounding-bear scenario (opex resumption plus SME softening together) and no bull-case re-rate; multiple sits modestly below today's already-compressed forward multiple (12.63x), reflecting the moat module's Narrow, borderline-durability verdict. 12-month horizon.

scenarios.label: bear
scenarios.metric_basis: FY27E EBITDA (FY27E revenue ≈₹16,004mn, +2%, near-flat SME demand, × 24% EBIT margin — below the company's own FY23/FY24 prior-trough margin of 24.44%/24.64% — + ₹200mn D&A)
scenarios.drivers: Customer-acquisition opex resumes toward management's own guided ~₹10cr/qtr run-rate while SME demand softens (paying-supplier net adds, already negative in 3 of the last 4 quarters, stay negative) — the specific compounding scenario earnings/07 §5 names as plausible. EBIT margin compresses below the company's own last true operating trough. Multiple compresses further below today's level and below the translated own-history band minimum. 12-month horizon.
